empty.prompt: Open a Markdown file or drop one anywhere on this window.
unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.beforeLeaving: Save changes to "{name}" before leaving it?
encoding.title: Save as UTF-8?
encoding.text: "{name}" uses the {encoding} encoding, which can't store some of the characters in it. Save it as UTF-8 instead?
banner.pasteNeedsSave: Pasted images are stored in an images folder next to the document, so it needs to be saved once.
banner.deletedText: The file is no longer on disk. Save to recreate it.
banner.changedText: Another program modified this file. Reload it and lose your edits?
banner.pdfNeedsSave: PDF export needs the document saved so its images can be found.
assoc.keepExe: Keep MarkView.exe in this folder. Windows opens .md files with the program at this exact location, so if it is moved or deleted, double-clicking .md files stops working. (If you move it, MarkView will offer to set this up again the next time you open it.)
assoc.temporary: This looks like a temporary folder (Downloads or Temp). Consider choosing "No" for now, moving MarkView.exe to a permanent folder such as {folder}, and opening it from there.
assoc.setupFailed: Could not set up file association
assoc.offerText: MarkView can be your app for Markdown files, so double-clicking a .md file opens it here.
assoc.offerNote: If you choose Yes, Windows Settings opens next so you can confirm MarkView as the default. Windows requires that step; apps cannot set it themselves.
assoc.registerNote: Windows Settings opens next so you can confirm MarkView as the default.
assoc.removeText: MarkView will no longer appear under "Open with" for Markdown files. If it is your default .md app, Windows will ask which app to use next time you open one.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Double-click the preview to jump to that line in the editor. Paste or drop images into the editor to add them to the document.
about.title: About MarkView
about.version:
MarkView {version}
A Markdown viewer and editor.
about.builtWith: Built with Rust, Tauri, WebView2, comrak, CodeMirror, highlight.js, Mermaid, KaTeX and github-markdown-css.
